steps.what: Retrieve the specified machine component and current cutting setup instruction for the production order
Select cutting blades, rollers or templates according to specifications and inspect actual component suitability
Install the selected machine components using hand tools under the existing safe isolation procedure
Check the actual installed components, alignment and fastening against the setup specification
Capture the actual installed component identifiers and installation check result in the setup note
Approve the final actual-component setup record and order association
Commit the approved actual setup record to the internal production order

tasks.design: Configure an order-linked setup reference in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}, and native commitment of the reviewed actual setup note. Selection, safe physical installation, checks and actual component capture remain human; only reference navigation and a separate final-version record commit change. Edits void record approval, and the tool never starts the machine, changes guards or substitutes planned components for those actually installed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Small reference and setup-record filing steps surround physical component installation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native production-order links and record fields can reduce navigation and filing.
tasks.still_hard: Actual fit, blade condition and safe mechanical installation.
tasks.human_edge: Inspect and install the real component safely.

ambition.what: Reduce administration around existing component setup.

tasks.altitude: Hands-on setup and accountability remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Keep approved component references tied to order revisions.

evidence.claim: Production systems can link approved setup references and store actual component records through native forms.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, not measured; all physical time remains full.
Engineering supplies approved order/component specifications in normal planning. s1 includes missing-reference checks; s5 manually captures actual component IDs, order and check result.
No machine-control or new operator-monitoring interface is introduced.
unknowns: Whether a separate actual setup note is required locally and how native filing works.
research_questions: Can existing order links remove any setup-reference navigation?

already_counted.description: Actual component record capture and final review.

incremental.description: Check setup-reference links after specification revisions.

approvals.approved_version: approved actual setup record version including installed component IDs, actual result and production order

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: two machine-setup reference-navigation hours saved less half an upkeep hour. Low: native order links remove most new benefit. Same-production-record commitment and physical setup retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor cutting-machine operation and supply needs.

steps.what: Monitor operation of cutting or slicing machines physically for malfunctions and supply replenishment needs
inputs: actual material feed and cut behavior

steps.what: Read existing machine status, counters and supply indicators in the native operator display
outputs: actual display readings and missing indicators

steps.what: Determine whether an observed malfunction or supply shortage needs immediate action under existing operating procedures
inputs: actual display readings and missing indicators

steps.what: Write the actual machine condition or replenishment concern and internal escalation recipient
outputs: final proposed condition note and escalation

steps.what: Approve the final actual condition note and named internal escalation recipient
inputs: final proposed condition note and escalation

steps.what: Commit the approved condition note to the internal machine log
Send the approved condition escalation to the named internal maintenance or supply colleague

tasks.design: Configure a simpler native status view in {OTHER}, the cutting-machine operator display, using only existing indicators. The operator still watches the machine, checks actual supplies, makes the assessment and writes actual concerns; separate approved actions commit the note in {OPS_SYSTEM} and send its internal escalation through {CHAT}. Changes void approval, urgent operating responses follow existing procedures immediately, and the proposal neither adds automatic machine control nor counts existing indicator runtime as labour savings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Operators navigate status pages and separately file and relay condition notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native read-only display configuration and approved note routing can reduce specific handling.
tasks.still_hard: Actual noise, vibration, cut behavior and supply conditions may be absent from sensors.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize a real malfunction and respond safely.

ambition.what: Reduce status navigation and condition-note handling.

reach.learn: Receive actual operator observations rather than an inferred fault diagnosis.

evidence.claim: Existing machine displays can sometimes be configured into a native status view; record systems can route approved condition notes.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, not observed; physical monitoring remains full.
The controller produces existing status/counter signals; s2 counts manual reading and checks of missing indicators. The operator produces actual condition, time, machine ID and recipient in s4.
No new sensors, predictive maintenance, automatic replenishment or staff tracking is assumed.
unknowns: Native display configuration support and actual condition-note practice.
research_questions: Does a native view reduce navigation while preserving all required checks?

already_counted.description: Actual condition capture and final escalation review.

incremental.description: Check display fields and escalation routing after changes.

approvals.approved_version: approved condition package version including actual observation and machine-log target
approved condition package version including escalation text and internal recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:4.5 status-navigation and two actual escalation-send hours saved less one upkeep. Low: native configuration removes most new benefit. Same-machine-log commitment and machine observation retain full effort.

steps.what: Retrieve the current cutting order, material sequence and approved team work instructions
Decide cutting-team assignments and coordination needs from actual material and worker readiness
Brief workers on their cutting-team tasks and verify understanding of safe coordination
Direct workers on cutting teams during actual work and resolve changing coordination problems
Capture actual team handover issues and outstanding coordination actions in a shift note
Approve the complete team handover note and internal shift-record destination
Commit the approved cutting-team handover note to the internal shift record

tasks.design: Configure current order and instruction links in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}. Work allocation, live briefing, direction and actual handover-note capture remain human; only context retrieval and a separate final-version shift-record commit change. Edits void approval, no staff scoring or machine direction is automated, and no instruction message is silently generated or sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current work instructions and filing the actual shift handover add small administrative steps.
tasks.enabler_now: Native order-linked references and shift-note fields can simplify handling.
tasks.still_hard: Changing material, worker readiness and safe coordination.
tasks.human_edge: See how the team is working and adapt direction in real time.

ambition.what: Reduce reference and filing work around team direction.

tasks.altitude: Team direction and accountability remain human.

reach.learn: Use actual outstanding issues in the shift note.

evidence.claim: Production systems can link current orders and instructions and file reviewed shift notes.

assumptions: Planners supply current order and instruction revisions in normal work; missing context is checked in s1. The operator captures actual outstanding issue, action and order reference in s5.
No new reporting burden is transferred to cutting-team members and no live direction time falls.
unknowns: Whether native order links and shift-note filing are already configured.
research_questions: Which reference and filing steps remain after existing production-system setup?

incremental.description: Maintain order-reference and shift-note routing fields.

approvals.approved_version: approved team handover version including actual outstanding issues and shift target

tasks.short: Position stone using cranes or signals.

steps.what: Read the applicable lift instructions and actual load and crane capacity markings
Inspect the actual stone, rigging, route and landing space and prepare safe lifting coordination
Operate cranes or signal crane operators to position or remove stone from cars or saw beds while watching the actual movement
outputs: stone moved to the intended position

steps.what: Confirm stable placement or removal and release the load and lifting coordination safely
inputs: stone moved to the intended position
outputs: physically completed and checked stone movement

tasks.design: Retain the manual crane-operation or signalling workflow. A native document view was considered for s1, but it cannot replace reading the actual load/capacity markings and the existing short lift instruction at the point of work; physical preparation, movement and placement checks remain unchanged. No record write, report or message is bundled into these physical steps, and no model or control integration is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work depends on the actual load, clearances and coordinated movement.
tasks.enabler_now: No software change in this design improves those physical actions.
tasks.still_hard: Safe load movement and responding to changing conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Maintain direct situational awareness and unambiguous crane signals.

ambition.what: No additional software service is proposed.

tasks.altitude: The person's crane and signalling duties remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Maintain direct lift coordination and clear signals.

evidence.claim: Direct crane operation and signalling depend on actual physical conditions; no software labour saving is established here.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, not measured; all four steps retain full time.
This routine movement uses existing lift instructions and actual load/capacity markings, read in s1. No new structured input is required.

A separate per-lift written log, permit write or electronic send is not assumed for this routine case. If local practice requires one, it must be decomposed and counted rather than folded into physical work.
Zero incremental upkeep is justified because no software, record workflow or model is introduced.
unknowns: Whether local lifting practice requires a separate per-lift record or permit.
research_questions: Is there an actual repeated lift-record or reference-navigation task to assess separately?

incremental.description: No new software, model or record workflow is introduced, so there is no incremental upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Existing instruction lookup and each physical action remain full; no new software or upkeep is proposed and no control runtime is credited.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
